sections.Profile:
The "Merry Widow" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation on October 24, 1963, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Women, Good Times, Dancing, Original Theme, Ballroom, Music, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Concept: Steve Kordek
sections.Editions: - Merry Widow: 2,150 made, released 1963-10-01, model number 291
